summary: Improve AP workflows, invoice controls, and automation planning. Explore the five-day course and build practical process deliverables.
lede: Accounts payable automation training helps AP leads and P2P owners assess invoice workflows and plan controlled improvements. It covers process mapping, invoice-cycle and exception measurement, approval routing, three-way matching, and control design, with practical work to prioritize automation and shape KPIs and change plans. OCR, robotic process automation, and AI-assisted capture are covered at an operational level, not as technical implementation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who lead, configure, monitor, or support accounts payable and procure-to-pay operations. It suits you if you need to improve invoice controls and workflow performance while coordinating finance, procurement, suppliers, and technology teams. This course is designed for: Accounts Payable Team Leads overseeing invoice queues, approvals, and payment readiness. P2P Process Owners mapping purchase-to-payment workflows and prioritizing automation opportunities. Invoice Processing Supervisors managing capture accuracy, coding quality, and exception backlogs. ERP Finance Functional Analysts maintaining AP workflow rules and approval configurations. Finance Transformation Managers coordinating automation scope, benefits, and implementation dependencies. AP Controls Specialists testing segregation of duties and invoice evidence trails. Accounts Payable Analysts monitoring cycle time, duplicate invoices, and exception trends. Procurement Operations Managers resolving purchase-order and receipt mismatches with AP teams. Supplier Enablement Specialists supporting electronic invoicing and invoice submission quality. Finance Systems Product Owners aligning AP requirements with ERP and automation teams.
modules: AP KPI Reporting and Automation Roadmap
prerequisites: Working knowledge of accounts payable or procure-to-pay invoice processing is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet use will help with the Excel-based KPI exercise.
